The Danville Community Center has 7,200 square feet for space, and provides a 2,380 square-foot banquet hall for 160 people, and opens a patio and one-acre Town Green. The Danville Library, an 18,000 square-foot building completed in 1996, is located adjacent to the Community Center. Set between the rolling foothills of Danville and Alamo, the 16.3-acre park remains separated from the surrounding residential area by mature oaks, pines and sycamores.
